headline: Liberty unbeaten in conference play, beaten at Tennessee
dek: Liberty's sixteen wins are more than any other program in the conference recorded, and the year's last result, a defeat at Tennessee, was only its third. The others came in August, at Virginia and Pitt.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Below WKU, Liberty and Delaware, season goals and the conference table part company: MTSU outscored the rest and still finished behind FIU and New Mexico State, the lowest scorer of all.

wire.line: WKU lost only twice all season, both times to Liberty.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches dated the day after the season opened, MTSU against Southern Miss and New Mexico State against Grand Canyon, still have no published result.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sam Houston drew seven of its matches, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Halle Engle scored eleven of Liberty's 36 goals, from 71 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Delaware conceded eighteen goals all season, and Sophia Hall kept a shutout in eight of its matches.

last_match.line: Liberty had not lost since August.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
